messages:
lucy: Canary in eu-west hit an admission webhook error after the chart promote. CRD change maybe?
marc: error logs?
lucy: kube-apiserver: `admission webhook "crd-validation.example.com" denied request: unknown field \"newField\" in CertificateSpec`
diego: we added `spec.certificate.newField` in chart v4.2.0 and bumped CRD in the chart, but I thought the CRD apply was gated to global leader only.
hannah: correct, CRD apply was part of the global promotion hook. Regions that got the chart before CRD apply will fail admission.
lucy: deploy-bot marked canary unhealthy and paused promotion. @deploy-bot status?
deploy-bot: Canary 3822223333-eu-west paused due to admission webhook failure. Action: hold and notify release-ops.
release-ops: options: 1) rollback chart in eu-west to previous chart (safe but loses feature), 2) force-apply CRD to eu-west cluster now (needs approval from infra), 3) pin chart to previous version regionally. Change window 40m.
marc: forcing CRD apply regionally is preferred since the change is additive, but infra requires a short review because CRDs are cluster-scoped.
diego: if we pin regionally, we can avoid cluster-scoped change during window and still keep other regions moving. downside: more manual unpin later.
hannah: thoughts?
marc: leaning force-apply CRD with quick review. I can prepare the CRD manifest and a short Risk note: additive schema change with no breaking removals.
lucy: If infra signs off, do that. Otherwise we should pin eu-west. I don't want to rollback; that will complicate release notes.
deploy-bot: infra requested approval: @release-ops please confirm CRD apply for eu-west cluster: `apply --server=eu-west-api -f crds/certificates.v1beta1.crd.yaml`
release-ops: approved for immediate apply after MARC posts the risk note and a pre/post checklist. Keep release annotation `crd-apply-eu-west` and set `rollback-if-fail=3822223600`.
marc: posted risk note in #infra-ops and attached pre/post checklist. Will apply CRD in 2 minutes.
ci-bot: scheduling job 3822223345 to apply CRD then re-run canary promote step.
marc: CRD applied successfully in eu-west. Re-running canary promote.
deploy-bot: Canaries re-run: pods coming up. Waiting on readiness.
lucy: pods are ready. running smoke tests now.
ci-bot: smoke tests passed. Canary healthy. Promotion will continue to remaining regions. :tada:
release-ops: decision recorded: force-apply CRD in eu-west (infra-approved) -> success -> no rollback. Follow-up: add gating rule to promotion pipeline to ensure CRD apply completes before region-level chart rollout in future.
diego: created GH issue to move CRD apply to an earlier promotion step and to add an automated CRD readiness check.
hannah: adding a release note bullet: "CRD schema change applied per-region; infra-approved. No rollback required."
lucy: thanks all. Small follow-up: add checklist item to chart PR template to call out CRD scope and required infra review."
